## What is TinyFolder?

 TinyFolder product thumbnail 

TinyFolder is a native macOS app launcher for Mac users whose Dock is crowded with apps they use together. It groups selected apps into custom folders with icon, list, or large tile layouts, then pins each folder directly to the Dock or opens it with a shortcut. It runs on macOS 13 and later on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, with no account required.

## Why TinyFolder works [...] FreeNo SpamUnsubscribe anytime

Frequently asked

## TinyFolder FAQ

How is TinyFolder different from a regular macOS folder?−

TinyFolder is built for launching apps from the Dock. It adds adaptive popup layouts, custom folder styles, live editing, and global keyboard shortcuts, while a regular macOS folder can also open files.

Which Macs does TinyFolder support?−

TinyFolder runs on macOS 13 and later on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

What is included in the free version?−

Starter is free forever with no account. It includes one folder with up to four apps, Liquid Glass styling, and direct Dock pinning.
